title: David flees to Gath and settles in Ziklag
description: David fled from Saul to the land of the Philistines and received Ziklag as a place of refuge from King Achish of Gath. David and his men raided among the Geshurites, Girzites, and Amalekites, but lied to Achish, claiming they had attacked areas in the Negev belonging to Israelites, so that Achish would believe David had made himself hated by his own people [ref:1 Sam 27:1-12|1. Samuel 27:1-12].
